personajes.rol: Vecino que espera su turno y resuelve todo desde el celular
personajes.fisicoEn: Argentine man, 38 years old, olive-toned skin, short dark brown hair slightly messy, trimmed stubble beard, tired expressive brown eyes with faint under-eye circles, medium build. Wearing a plain navy blue short-sleeve polo shirt, grey work trousers and worn sneakers, a lanyard-free look, holding a paper queue ticket in one hand and a small potted green plant in the other. Everyday working-class neighbor look, photorealistic skin texture, natural pores, deadpan charisma.
personajes.fisicoEs: Hombre de 38, piel oliva, pelo castaño corto, barba corta, cara de cansado con turno y planta en mano
personajes.vestuario: Chomba azul marino, pantalón gris de trabajo, zapatillas gastadas

personajes.rol: Empleada municipal detrás del mostrador de atención al vecino
personajes.fisicoEn: Argentine woman, 52 years old, light tan skin, shoulder-length dyed dark blonde hair pulled back, reading glasses low on the nose, subtle laugh lines. Wearing a light blue municipal staff shirt with a small embroidered city crest on the chest, plain cardigan over the shoulders and a laminated ID badge on a lanyard. Seated behind a public service counter with stacks of paper folders, photorealistic, warm but bureaucratic presence.
personajes.fisicoEs: Mujer de 52, pelo rubio oscuro recogido, anteojos, camisa celeste municipal con credencial
personajes.vestuario: Camisa celeste municipal, cárdigan y credencial colgada

lugar.nombre: Sala de espera de atención al vecino en el municipio
lugar.descripcionEn: Interior of a small-town Argentine municipal public service waiting room: rows of joined grey plastic chairs bolted to the floor, worn speckled linoleum, a wall-mounted red LED queue number display, a ceiling loudspeaker, a paper ticket dispenser, an attention counter with glass partition and stacks of paper folders, printed signs and notices taped to a pale institutional wall, a cork board with municipal announcements, a dusty water cooler in the corner. Flat cold fluorescent ceiling lighting with a slight green-grey cast, static locked-off vertical 9:16 framing, documentary photorealistic look, shallow depth of field on the foreground chair, bright clean warm phone screen glow contrasting against the grey room.
lugar.luz: Fluorescente gris frío, con el celular cálido como único foco nítido
